title: Students onboarded through a school code without verified guardian consent
setting: Murshid requires guardian OTP verification for 13-17s and blocks under-13s with a neutral age gate. All details are synthetic.

events.text: Internal audit: 63 accounts aged 13-17 joined with the school join code OOW-G11; the guardian e-mail OTP step was skipped by a bug in the school onboarding path. Their timetables and grades are being synced from the school connector.
Asked by Murshid, the school says parents signed a generic 'educational technology' clause in the enrolment contract and it considers that sufficient consent for any EdTech tool.
Two of the 63 accounts belong to 12-year-olds (Grade 7) who typed a wrong birth year; the self-declared age gate let them through.
A guardian asks the Data Office who is responsible, the school or the app, and asks for all of her child's data to be deleted.
